instruction: Tidy up the desk: toy blocks go in the purple toy box, mugs go on the cyan tray and the pen stands upright in the magenta pen holder.

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
zone = obs["zones"]["purple_box"]

candidates = grasp_candidates("red_block")
valid_candidates = [c for c in candidates if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True)]
best_candidate = max(valid_candidates, key=lambda c: c.get("score") or 0.0) if valid_candidates else candidates[0]

res = grasp(best_candidate)
if res["holding_something"]:
    target_yaw = zone["long_axis_yaw"] + (
        best_candidate["yaw"] - best_candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"]
    )
    # The box has a rim height of 0.05m; carry above it and lower inside
    carry_to(zone["center"][0], zone["center"][1], height=0.18, yaw=target_yaw)
    lower_until_contact()
    open_gripper()
    retreat(0.12)
    go_home()
    check("red_block", "purple_box")
